env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.for: OpenAI chat and image generation (paid by usage)

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.for: Google Gemini chat (free tier, then paid)

env.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
env.for: DeepSeek chat (paid by usage, low cost)

env.name: AI_API_KEY
env.for: optional OpenAI-compatible fallback key for chat, coding, writing and image understanding
env.where: Your AI provider's dashboard, API keys section

env.name: AI_BASE_URL
env.for: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the fallback (defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1)

env.name: AI_MODEL
env.for: model id used by the fallback provider

env.name: DAILY_LIMIT
env.for: requests allowed per device per day (default 100)

env.name: VIDEO_API_KEY
env.for: future video-generation integration (not active in this version)
